what_it_does: This work automates the detection of reliable hardware performance counters for high-performance computing systems. Hardware performance counters are sensors built into processors that measure events like cache misses or processor cycles, but they generate unreliable data in real systems. The paper presents a tool that runs repeated experiments, analyzes the noise patterns in different counters, and ranks them by how stable their measurements are, helping researchers select trustworthy counters for performance modeling.
